job_id.rationale: Job ID is an identifier and does not affect security; only identifies the operation.

project.description: If it is not provided, the provider project is used.
project.rationale: Project ID is an organizational identifier and does not directly impact security.

bucket_list.description: List of buckets and their objects to be transformed.
bucket_list.rationale: Bucket list configuration is required for batch operations but doesn't directly impact security.

buckets.description: List of buckets and their objects to be transformed.
buckets.rationale: Bucket configuration is required for batch operations but doesn't directly impact security.

bucket.description: Bucket name for the objects to be transformed.
bucket.rationale: Bucket name is required for batch operations but doesn't directly impact security.

prefix_list.description: Specifies objects matching a prefix set. Required for scoping operations to specific objects.
prefix_list.rationale: Without proper prefix scoping, operations may affect unintended objects in the bucket.

included_object_prefixes.description: List of object name prefixes to include in the batch operation.
included_object_prefixes.rationale: Prefixes ensure operations are scoped to specific objects, preventing accidental mass operations.

manifest.description: Contains the manifest source file that is a CSV file in a Google Cloud Storage bucket.
manifest.rationale: Manifest files provide explicit object lists, ensuring operations only affect intended objects.

manifest_location.description: Specifies objects in a manifest file stored in Cloud Storage.
manifest_location.rationale: Valid manifest location ensures operations target only explicitly listed objects.

delete_object.description: Allows batch operations to delete objects in bucket.
delete_object.rationale: Permanent deletion can cause data loss if misused. Policy ensures delete safety.

permanent_object_deletion_enabled.description: Enable flag to permanently delete object and all object versions if versioning is enabled on bucket.
permanent_object_deletion_enabled.rationale: Permanent deletion removes recovery options and poses a major security risk for data loss.

rewrite_object.description: Allows update of encryption key for objects in bucket.
rewrite_object.rationale: All rewrites must use CMEK to ensure customer-controlled encryption.

kms_key.description: Valid KMS key for encryption during rewrite operations.
kms_key.rationale: CMEK ensures encryption is customer-managed rather than default Google-managed keys.

put_object_hold.description: Allows update of temporary hold or eventBased hold for objects.
put_object_hold.rationale: Unsetting holds can weaken data retention and allow premature deletion.

event_based_hold.description: Set/unset to update event based hold for objects.
event_based_hold.rationale: Unsetting event-based holds can allow premature deletion of objects that should be retained.

temporary_hold.description: Set/unset to update temporary based hold for objects.
temporary_hold.rationale: Unsetting temporary holds can allow premature deletion of objects that should be retained.

put_metadata.description: Allows batch operations to update metadata for objects in bucket.
put_metadata.rationale: Metadata updates are generally safe operations that don't affect data integrity or security.

custom_time.description: Updates the objects fixed custom time metadata.
custom_time.rationale: Custom time metadata is informational and doesn't impact security.

content_disposition.rationale: Content disposition is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

content_encoding.description: Content Encoding of the object data.
content_encoding.rationale: Content encoding is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

content_type.rationale: Content type is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

content_language.rationale: Content language is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

cache_control.description: Cache-Control directive to specify caching behavior of object data. If omitted and object is accessible to all anonymous users, the default will be public, max-age=3600
cache_control.rationale: Cache control is a metadata field that doesn't affect security.

custom_metadata.rationale: Custom metadata is informational and doesn't impact security.
